items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: And it was there that I was out there with Sy Oliver and Mercer.

ctx.x: I was in three camps. First I was in Camp Upton, New Jersey. Then I went to Camp Kilmer, no Camp Upton, Camp Shanks was second. That's in Orange, New Jersey. And it was there that I was out there with Sy Oliver and Mercer.
